name: neuroquiz
description: Mobile-friendly neuroanatomy quiz for medical students.

scripts.ios:prepare: npm run validate:data && npm run build:app-data && npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:swiftui:build: npm run build:app-data && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/SwiftUIPrototype/NeuroQuizSwiftUIPrototype.xcodeproj -scheme NeuroQuizSwiftUIPrototype -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.xcode:doctor: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -version && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun --find mcpbridge && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun simctl list runtimes
